Usage: gacli admin bigquery-links create [options]

Create a BigQuery link

Options:
  --project <projectId>                 Google Cloud project ID
  --daily-export-enabled <enabled>      Enable daily export (true/false)
                                        (default: "true")
  --streaming-export-enabled <enabled>  Enable streaming export (true/false)
                                        (default: "false")
  -h, --help                            display help for command
